selection_rule.episode_unit: one episode; attempts are paired observations only

exclusive_conflict_class.both_U_and_D: assign the episode to the class with largest absolute primary_gm_delta; ties resolve U before D, then child_attempt_id

within_cell_rank.U: descending absolute primary_gm_delta, descending pass_count_delta, descending edit_count, episode_id
within_cell_rank.D: descending absolute primary_gm_delta, ascending pass_count_delta, descending edit_count, episode_id
within_cell_rank.N: descending edit_count, descending primary pair pass_count_delta, descending primary pair primary_gm_delta, episode_id

selection_rule.quota_reallocation: begin with 3 per D2/D3+ x easy/medium/hard x U/D/N cell; after calibration exclusion, infeasible D2 U seats remain explicit and remaining seats are assigned to D3+ conflict cells as recorded in stratum_summary
selection_rule.hps_selection_guard: no HPS score, sidecar, or image quality re-evaluation is read by this selector
